chrome_get_windows_and_tabs.description: Get all currently open browser windows and tabs

chrome_navigate.description: Navigate to a URL, refresh the current tab, or navigate browser history (back/forward)

url.description: URL to navigate to. Special values: "back" or "forward" to navigate browser history in the target tab.

newWindow.description: Create a new window to navigate to the URL or not. Defaults to false

tabId.description: Target an existing tab by ID (if provided, navigate/refresh/back/forward that tab instead of the active tab).

windowId.description: Target an existing window by ID (when creating a new tab in existing window, or picking active tab if tabId is not provided).

background.description: Perform the operation without stealing focus (do not activate the tab or focus the window). Default: true (set false only if user explicitly asks to bring tab to foreground)

width.description: Window width in pixels (default: 1280). When width or height is provided, a new window will be created.

height.description: Window height in pixels (default: 720). When width or height is provided, a new window will be created.

refresh.description: Refresh the current active tab instead of navigating to a URL. When true, the url parameter is ignored. Defaults to false

groupTitle.description: Concise, task-aligned title for the Chrome tab group reflecting user intent in user language (e.g. "京东显示器销量前十", "GitHub PR Review"). If omitted, the extension derives a smart title dynamically from the destination domain and page title instead of generic fallback.

groupColor.description: Color for the Chrome tab group. Fallback: "blue"

autoGroup.description: Automatically place newly opened tab into an Agent-managed tab group with dedicated title and color. Default: true

chrome_screenshot.description: [Prefer browserclaw_read_dom over taking a screenshot] Take a screenshot of the current page or a specific element. Returns base64 image directly in MCP image content block without writing to disk. By default, output is compressed JPEG with maxWidth <= 1280px. Debug disk save is available via savePng/saveToDisk into system temporary directory.

name.description: Name or label for the screenshot. Purely in-memory by default; only written to disk if savePng/saveToDisk is explicitly set to true.

selector.description: CSS selector for element to screenshot

assetIndex.description: View one visual asset listed by browserclaw_read_dom ([asset N] lines): returns the real image resource; falls back to a viewport crop when bytes are unavailable

tabId.description: Target tab ID to capture from (default: active tab).

windowId.description: Target window ID to pick active tab from when tabId is not provided.

background.description: Attempt capture without bringing tab/window to foreground. CDP-based capture is used for viewport captures. Default: true

maxWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels for compression (default: 1280)

storeBase64.description: Return screenshot in base64 format in text content (image content is always returned directly)

fullPage.description: Capture a full-page scroll screenshot with GoFullPage-grade industrial stitching: automatic StyleStack fixed/sticky header de-duplication, page warmup for lazy-loading/skeletons, dynamic height change recovery, and captureVisibleTab quota backoff retry (default: false).

maxHeight.description: Maximum height in pixels to capture for full-page screenshots (default: 50000, protects against infinite scroll runaway).

savePng.description: Save screenshot to system temporary directory for debugging (default: false, zero disk write by default)

saveToDisk.description: Deprecated alias for savePng (default: false, zero disk write by default; saves to system temp, not Downloads). Prefer savePng.

som.description: Overlay Set-of-Mark numbered badges on interactive elements before capturing the screenshot

highlight.description: Deprecated alias for som; still accepted but hidden from the schema to keep it small. Prefer som.

setOfMark.description: Alias for som (Set-of-Mark overlay); accepted for parity with som.

mode.description: Capture mode. "som" = Set-of-Mark: annotated image plus a textual element map on one shared numbering scheme.

zoom.description: Zoom crop mode: label numbers to zoom into (crop around each label's safe click point, scaled up).

targetIndex.description: Compact 1-based numeric index of target element from browserclaw_read_dom to crop and capture only this specific region of interest

index.description: Alias for targetIndex: compact 1-based numeric index of target element from browserclaw_read_dom to crop and capture

padding.description: Padding in pixels to expand around targetIndex crop area (default: 0)

region.description: Lossless high-density ROI crop: capture only a specific sub-region { x0, y0, x1, y1 } in CSS pixels or polymorphic [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]. Completely avoids downscaling and preserves full pixel clarity for fine details like small text or dice dots.

crop.description: Alias for region: { x, y, width, height } or { x0, y0, x1, y1 }.

grid.description: Overlay semi-transparent coordinate reference grid with perimeter tape measure rulers (20/50/100px ticks) and interior reticle crosshairs (+) to eliminate visual estimation hallucination (default: false)

enableGrid.description: Alias for grid: overlay semi-transparent coordinate reference grid with perimeter tape measure rulers and crosshairs

expandSearchArea.description: For small elements (< 100x100), adaptively expand the crop bounding box to preserve surrounding headers and text context (default: true)

format.description: Image output format: webp (default, high compression for LLM), jpeg, or png

quality.description: Image compression quality from 0 to 100 for webp/jpeg formats (default: 80)

highClarity.description: Prioritize 100% full-resolution clarity without downsampling (disables dimension scaling, keeps 1:1 CSS pixel sharpness for reading fine details or dice dots).

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier to bind affinity to a specific tab context

chrome_close_tabs.description: Close one or more browser tabs

tabId.description: Single tab ID to close (convenience alternative to tabIds array).

tabIds.description: Array of tab IDs to close. If not provided, will close the active tab (requires confirm: true or session affinity).

url.description: Close tabs matching this URL. Can be used instead of tabIds.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation required to close the active tab when tabIds or url are not specified.

allManagedGroups.description: Close all Agent-managed tab groups and their tabs created during automation sessions. Default: false

chrome_switch_tab.description: Switch to a specific browser tab

tabId.description: The ID of the tab to switch to.

windowId.description: The ID of the window where the tab is located.

background.description: If true, binds session affinity only without activating the tab in the Chrome UI or stealing user focus. Default: false

chrome_read_dom.description: Extract and prune interactive DOM tree with compact 1-based index assignment, viewport boundary filtering, and occlusion pruning. Supports scoped container targeting (selector) and noise exclusion (exclude) to eliminate full DOM dump overhead.

selector.description: CSS selector to scope parsing to a specific container/element (e.g. "#main-cart", ".dialog-box"). Only descendants and self within matching containers are indexed.

scope.description: Alias for selector. CSS selector to scope parsing to a specific container/element (e.g. "#main-cart", ".dialog-box"). Only descendants and self within matching containers are indexed.

isolateModal.description: When true and an active modal dialog is detected, restricts indexing to the active modal while strictly protecting portals, dropdowns, and alert containers.

exclude.description: CSS selector(s) to exclude from parsing (e.g. "#footer, #recommendations, .ad-banner"). Matching elements and their entire subtrees are pruned.

viewportThreshold.description: Vertical threshold in pixels for viewport boundary checking (default 1000)

highlight.description: Whether to visually highlight indexed elements

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier to bind affinity to a specific tab context

cursor.description: Pagination cursor offset for traversing very large DOM pages incrementally (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of indexed elements to return for current page cursor slice (default: unlimited)

maxTextLength.description: Maximum text length before truncation for element text content (default: 120)

maxChars.description: Hard character budget for the serialized response (default: 120000). When the pruned tree would exceed it the response is cut and carries "truncated": true plus "totalChars" (the true untruncated length).

includeDetails.description: Also return the bulky indexedElements/indexMap detail blocks (geometry, occlusion flags, safe click points). Off by default because the tree already carries index/tag/attributes/text; enable only when you need per-element rects or visibility flags.

viewportOnly.description: When true, only index elements inside or immediately near the visible viewport (default: false)

activeViewportOnly.description: When true, strictly constrains indexing to elements currently visible within the active viewport (threshold = 0) with horizontal/vertical frustum clipping, eliminating ghost elements from SPA wizards, carousels, and multi-step forms.

format.description: Output format for treeString. "compact" (default) produces a concise, accessibility-tree-inspired representation without closing tags, slashing token usage by 60%+. "html" returns legacy pseudo-HTML tags.

deltaOnly.description: Delta mode (default: true). A repeat read that sees a changed DOM returns only changed/added/removed diffs against the previous snapshot (with the baseline snapshotId), saving 90%+ tokens. Set false to always receive the full tree.

flattenCards.description: When true (default: true), identifies composite card containers (article, [role="article"], [role="listitem"], li) and aggregates fragmented leaf nodes into unified structured card summaries while preserving actionable link/click indices. Slashes token usage by 60%+ on eCommerce, search feeds, and news listings.

chrome_interact_index.description: Click, hover, or interact with an element using its compact 1-based numeric index from browserclaw_read_dom. When performing predictable multi-step actions (e.g. form submission or chain navigation), prefer browserclaw_batch_actions to finish in a single round-trip.

index.description: Compact 1-based numeric index of the target element

oneOf.description: Point [x, y] or bounding box [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]

coordinate.description: Visual fallback coordinates in viewport/CSS pixels: { x, y } object, [x, y] point, or [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] bounding box (supports 0~1.0 normalized, 0~1000 per-mille, or absolute viewport pixels across modern vision agents).

coordinateSpace.description: Coordinate reference space. "viewport" (default) assumes standard CSS viewport pixels. "screenshot" scales coordinates based on the latest screenshot capture resolution.

autoSnap.description: When clicking via coordinates or visual fallback, magnetically snap to the closest interactive element if clicked within 24px of whitespace. Default: true.

points.description: Click sequence: dispatch a full CDP click at each viewport point with intervalMs pacing (rapid burst for moving canvas targets)

intervalMs.description: Delay between points in the click sequence, 5-500ms (default 35)

action.description: Interaction action to perform (default: click). "drag" requires `end` and moves from the indexed element to that target.

path.description: Continuous drag path: an ordered array of { x, y } coordinates to smoothly drag the mouse through while pressed. Ideal for circular gestures, sliders, and drawing on canvas.

index.description: 1-based index (from browserclaw_read_dom) of the drag destination element

coordinate.description: Drag destination as viewport coordinates when no index is available

end.description: Drag destination: { index } for an indexed element, or { coordinate: { x, y } } for a raw point. Required when action is "drag".

steps.description: Number of intermediate mouse-move steps for drag (default 48; lower is faster, higher is smoother)

holdMs.description: How long to hold the mouse button before dragging, in ms (default 80, range 0-3000)

dnd.description: Use HTML5 drag-and-drop events (dragstart/dragover/drop) instead of raw mouse moves. Needed for React/HTML5 DnD lists.

modifiers.description: Keyboard modifiers to hold during interaction

waitForSettle.description: Wait for DOM mutations to settle (quiet for 150ms or timeout) after interaction before returning (default: false)

settleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum settle timeout in milliseconds (default: 1500, range: 200-10000)

humanize.description: Simulate realistic human-like cursor trajectory with micro-jitter before clicking (default: false)

includeDelta.description: Automatically capture and return DOM changes caused by this interaction in the delta field (default: false)

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier to bind affinity to a specific tab context

pierceOverlay.description: Automatically pierce non-opaque or transient backdrop masks/loading stubs when intercepted (default: true)

waitForNetworkQuiescence.description: Wait for in-flight network requests to settle after this interaction before returning (default: false)

urlPattern.description: URL pattern or substring to match (e.g. "*/api/order*", "/checkout")

method.description: Optional HTTP method to filter by (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.)

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the matching network response (default: 5000ms)

statusCodes.description: Optional HTTP status codes to accept (e.g. [200, 201])

captureNetwork.description: Inline capture of network response triggered by this interaction in a single round-trip

condition.description: Post-action assertion kind evaluated against the page after the action completes.

expected.description: Expected value for the condition. Pass uses JSON equality, except text_present (substring) and url_matches (exact string or /regex/ literal).

postConditions.description: Optional post-action assertions; one auditable result per spec is reported top-level and via the result envelope (verdict/outcome).

chrome_fill_index.description: Fill text into an input or textarea element using its compact 1-based numeric index. For single search/form submission, pass pressEnter: true to fill and submit in 1 turn without needing a separate click. When filling multiple fields or clicking submit, use browserclaw_batch_actions to pipeline in 1 turn.

index.description: Compact 1-based numeric index of the target element

text.description: Text content to fill into the element

clear.description: Whether to clear existing field content before typing (default: true)

pressEnter.description: Whether to dispatch an Enter key event immediately after filling the text (default: false). Strongly recommended for search boxes and single-input queries to trigger immediate submission in 1 turn.

submit.description: Whether to automatically submit the form after filling (default: false). If true, clicks the detected submit button or presses Enter, completing fill + submit in 1 turn.

waitForSettle.description: Wait for DOM mutations to settle after filling text before returning (default: false)

settleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum settle timeout in milliseconds (default: 1500, range: 200-10000)

includeDelta.description: Automatically capture and return DOM changes caused by filling in the delta field (default: false)

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier to bind affinity to a specific tab context

condition.description: Post-action assertion kind evaluated against the page after the action completes.

expected.description: Expected value for the condition. Pass uses JSON equality, except text_present (substring) and url_matches (exact string or /regex/ literal).

postConditions.description: Optional post-action assertions; one auditable result per spec is reported top-level and via the result envelope (verdict/outcome).

chrome_batch_actions.description:
Execute a sequential multi-step pipeline of browser actions in a single round-trip without waiting for intermediate model turns.
* CRITICAL EFFICIENCY RULE: When the next 2+ actions are predictable (e.g. form filling: [fill username, fill password, click submit]; or search flow: [fill query, press Enter, wait]), ALWAYS use browserclaw_batch_actions instead of individual tool calls. It completes the entire sequence in 1 turn (3~5x faster, 75%+ lower token cost).
* Supported action types: click, double_click, right_click, fill, hover, scroll, press_key, wait, fill_form, assert, extract.
* Set includeDelta: true to automatically inspect DOM changes after the pipeline completes.

ref.description: Target element numeric index or ref from browserclaw_read_dom

selector.description: CSS selector or XPath for target element

pressEnter.description: Whether to dispatch an Enter key event immediately after filling the text (for type: fill)

submit.description: Whether to automatically submit the form after filling (clicks detected submit button or presses Enter) (for type: fill)

ref.description: Target element numeric index or ref from browserclaw_read_dom

selector.description: CSS selector or XPath for target field

fields.description: Array of field descriptors to fill sequentially (for fill_form)

oneOf.description: Point [x, y] or bounding box [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]

coordinate.description: Unified coordinate object or array for click or scroll

at.description: Absolute epoch-ms deadline: sleep until this instant before executing this action (extension-side timer, no extra round-trip)

direction.description: Scroll direction (left/right dispatch horizontal wheel deltas)

waitForSettle.description: Wait for DOM mutations to settle after this specific action (default: false)

settleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum settle timeout in milliseconds for this action (default: 1500)

waitForNetworkQuiescence.description: Wait for in-flight network requests to settle before proceeding to next action (default: false)

pierceOverlay.description: Automatically pierce non-opaque or transient backdrop masks for click actions (default: true)

preferComposer.description: Prioritize rich composer/editor elements over generic search inputs when resolving textbox (default: false)

expectedText.description: Expected text substring or exact match

condition.description: Assertion condition: contains, not_contains, equals, matches (regex), visible, not_visible, enabled, disabled, valid, invalid, checked, unchecked (default: "contains")

timeoutMs.description: Async polling timeout in milliseconds for assertion settling (default: 300ms)

abortOnFailure.description: Abort batch if assertion fails (default: true)

variableName.description: Key name under extractedData to store the result

urlPattern.description: URL pattern or substring to match (e.g. "*/api/order*")

method.description: Optional HTTP method to filter by (GET, POST, etc.)

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the network response (default: 5000ms)

statusCodes.description: Optional HTTP status codes to accept

captureNetwork.description: Inline capture of network response triggered by this action

actions.description: List of actions to execute sequentially

waitForSettle.description: Wait for DOM mutations to settle after all actions before returning (default: false)

settleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum settle timeout in milliseconds (default: 1500, range: 200-10000)

waitForNetworkQuiescence.description: Wait for in-flight network requests to settle after all actions before returning (default: false)

includeDelta.description: Automatically capture and return DOM changes caused by the batch in the delta field (default: false)

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier to bind affinity to a specific tab context

urlPattern.description: URL pattern or substring to match (e.g. "*/api/order*", "/checkout")

method.description: Optional HTTP method to filter by (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.)

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the matching network response (default: 5000ms)

statusCodes.description: Optional HTTP status codes to accept (e.g. [200, 201])

captureNetwork.description: Inline capture of network response triggered during batch execution in a single round-trip

chrome_get_markdown.description: Extract clean, structured hierarchical markdown from the active tab DOM stripped of SPA state blobs, hidden text, and scripts.

includeLinks.description: Whether to preserve hyperlinks in markdown (default: true)

fit.description: Content-only extraction: restrict to the main content region and strip nav/header/footer/aside/form noise before conversion (default: false)

selector.description: CSS selector limiting markdown extraction to that subtree (querySelector) instead of the whole body

maxLength.description: Hard character budget for the returned markdown (default: 120000). Longer markdown is cut and a notice carrying the true original length is appended.

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier to bind affinity to a specific tab context

chrome_smart_scroll.description: Intelligently detects and scrolls the most prominent scrollable container on the page, or targets a specific container by selector, ref, or coordinate with automatic progress calculation.

amount.description: Scroll amount: number in pixels, "page" (viewport height), or "half_page" (default: "page")

selector.description: Optional CSS selector of the scroll container to target

ref.description: Optional 1-based numeric index of the scroll container to target

index.description: Alias for ref: 1-based numeric index of the scroll container to target

oneOf.description: Point [x, y] or bounding box [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]

coordinate.description: Optional coordinate to locate the scrollable container under pointer: { x, y } object, [x, y] point, or [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] bounding box

smooth.description: Whether to use smooth scrolling behavior (default: true)

waitForSettle.description: Wait for DOM and network activity to settle after scroll completes (default: true)

settleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum settle wait timeout in ms (default: 1500)

chrome_tool_docs.description: Return compact parameter documentation for a category of BrowserClaw tools (navigate | perceive | act | observe | manage | crawl | diagnose | network | power). Use when a workflow needs a tool that is not in the current profile view. The "power" category is tier 3 (javascript, cdp_execute): it can read document.cookie and drive arbitrary input, so it is session-gated — it is disclosed here but only unlocked for the session when activateForSession is true.

activateForSession.description: When true, dynamically exposes all tools in this category for the current MCP session without server restart. Default: false

chrome_inspect_media.description: Inspect and extract high-fidelity media assets (images, canvas, captchas, icons) directly by element index or selector. Uses in-memory lossless extraction for /, with super-sampled 200%+ crop fallback for complex DOM containers.

chrome_grep.description: Search the page without dumping full DOM tree. Supports searching interactive elements (returning indices for browserclaw_interact_index), all DOM nodes, or raw visible text lines.

isRegex.description: Whether to evaluate query as a regular expression (default: false)

searchType.description: Search target: "interactive_only" (default, matches clickable/fillable elements and returns indices), "all_dom" (matches all elements), "page_text" (scans visible text lines).

limit.description: Maximum matching results to return (default: 20, max: 50)

chrome_act_toward_goal.description: Autonomous semantic micro-loop that perceives, decides, and acts toward a natural-language goal within a local Native Server loop (~200-400ms/step). Powered by TypeSafe Jev System One with seamless fallback to heuristic scoring when no API key is available or on quota/network degradation. Automatically escalates ambiguous, destructive, or complex actions back to the macro planner with pre-fetched page context.

goal.description: Natural language goal or objective to advance toward on the current page

tabId.description: Target tab ID (optional, defaults to active tab)

maxSteps.description: Maximum decision steps before terminating (default: 10, max: 60; heuristic capped at <= 5)

timeoutMs.description: Total execution timeout in milliseconds (default: 90000, max: 300000)

textHint.description: Explicit text hint to enter when typing, if not clearly quoted in goal

confidenceThreshold.description: Minimum confidence threshold to commit an action (default: 0.55)

pauseBeforeKeywords.description: List of keywords (e.g. ["Post", "Submit", "Pay"]). If the predicted action targets an element whose label, text, or role matches any keyword, the micro-loop suspends before execution and returns status "paused" with target element context for System 2 confirmation.

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier to bind affinity to a specific tab context

chrome_insert_media.description: Injects an image or media asset from local disk, URL, or base64 into a rich-text composer (e.g. Reddit, Twitter/X, Notion, Discord, Slack, GitHub) or targeted element via synthesized ClipboardEvent("paste") and DragEvent("drop") containing a real File object in DataTransfer, bypassing browser clipboard security sandboxes.

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the image or media file on local disk (e.g. "C:/images/diagram.png" or "/tmp/photo.jpg")

fileUrl.description: Remote HTTP/HTTPS URL to fetch the image or media asset from

base64Data.description: Base64-encoded media data string, optionally with "data:<mime>;base64," prefix

fileName.description: Optional filename to associate with the injected file (e.g. "architecture.png")

mimeType.description: MIME type of the media (e.g. "image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/gif", "image/webp", "image/svg+xml"). Auto-detected if omitted.

index.description: 1-based compact element index from browserclaw_read_dom targeting the rich-text editor or composer. Defaults to active element or discovered composer.

selector.description: CSS selector for the target container (optional fallback for index)

tabId.description: Target tab ID (optional, defaults to active tab)

sessionId.description: Session identifier for tab affinity binding

chrome_scroll_until_found.description: Performs client-side step-by-step scrolling until an element matching a text query, regex, or selector is found. Waits for virtual lists (DOM recycling) to settle at each step, searches light and shadow DOM, centers the target in the viewport, and returns its 1-based index and safe coordinates.

query.description: Text query or keyword to search for during scrolling

selector.description: CSS selector to search for during scrolling (supports >>> and /deep/ shadow piercing)

isRegex.description: Treat query as a regular expression pattern (default: false)

maxSteps.description: Maximum number of scroll steps before giving up (default: 10, max: 50)

stepPx.description: Scroll distance in pixels per step (default: 800)

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the overall scrolling operation (default: 15000)

containerSelector.description: CSS selector for a custom scrollable container (defaults to window)

settleMs.description: Delay in milliseconds to wait for virtual lists / DOM recycling after each scroll (default: 150)

tabId.description: Target tab ID (optional, defaults to active tab)

sessionId.description: Session identifier for tab affinity binding

chrome_extract.description: Tier-2 schema-typed extraction (browser_extract): extracts the fields a JSON Schema declares from the page/HTML root, with source attribution. Each key resolves via [data-field="key"] -> #key -> [name="key"] -> class match -> optional per-property selector -> label text; form controls read value, other elements read textContent, and declared number/integer/boolean types are coerced. Returns { data, missing, sourceRefs } — a key with no source element is reported in missing and is never invented into data.

schema.description: JSON Schema object describing the fields to extract: { type: 'object', properties: { <key>: { type: 'string'|'number'|'integer'|'boolean', description?, selector? } }, required?: string[] }

selector.description: CSS selector scoping extraction to a subtree (optional; defaults to the whole document)

tabId.description: Target tab ID (optional, defaults to the active/affinity tab)

sessionId.description: Session identifier for tab affinity binding (optional)
